dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I saw those guys at the park yesterday. They were about to tới công chuyện with each other. Looked very nguy hiểm.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Tới công chuyện? You mean đánh nhau? You shouldn't go near such nguy hiểm places. In Vietnam, I sometimes see these things happen.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: That's right, đánh nhau. Perhaps you don't know, but in Russia, I've seen many more tới công chuyện scenes than that. My father... he used to be involved in such things.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Really? I wouldn't think a girl like you would be connected to things like that. What did your father do in Russia?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Not something I want to tell someone I just met. But if you really want to know about my father and why I came to Vietnam... maybe we should meet at a coffee shop. Do you want to hear about it?
